title: Fejes Tóth sausage conjecture
statement: In every dimension d≥5 and for every finite number of congruent balls, placing their centers collinearly with consecutive balls tangent minimizes the volume of their convex hull.

counterexample.description: A dimension d≥5 and a finite exact nonoverlapping ball configuration whose convex-hull volume is smaller than that of the corresponding sausage arrangement.
